---
title: "Personal Visualization Journey"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse) 
workout_log = read.csv("Workout Log.csv")
```




```{r}
workout_log |>
  filter(Workout == "Ppl X Arnold (Push)") |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = Weight, x = Reps, color = Exercise)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  labs(title = "Push Day Execrises", 
       subtitle = "Info: it displays each Execrises reps and the amount of weight I do during this day")
```
```{r}
workout_log |>
  filter(Workout == "Ppl X Arnold (Push)") |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = Weight, x = Reps, color = Exercise)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  facet_wrap(~ Exercise, scales = "free_y") + 
  labs(title = "Push Day Execrises", 
       subtitle ="it displays each Execrises reps and the amount of weight I do during this day")
```
